title: Thai Gigantes Plaki Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Thai-inspired stew featuring giant white beans, similar to the traditional Greek plaki, made with Thai spices and herbs.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add garlic and ginger; cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Add onions; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add cumin and coriander; cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add soaked and drained giant white beans, fish sauce, and brown sugar; stir to combine.
Add the beans and their liquid; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low; simmer, covered, until the beans are tender, about 20-25 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro, if desired.
